profile.headline: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
profile.summary:
• Life-long focus on automation, detailed documentation, client satisfaction, and mentoring
• 2 years of leading SRE team through on-premise infrastructure challenges and data center migration
• 8+ years of building infrastructure and on-call support for AWS and on-premise environments
• 13+ years developing software and shipping code
• 11+ years close collaboration with client support teams to triage and resolve hundreds of issues

Experienced software crafter who believes in testing where it counts, refactoring when it matters, and paying down technical debt. Experienced with DevOps, infrastructure as code, and automation. Quick learner, enjoy diving into new projects, technical challenges, and systems. Love to document and automate. Ready to go down the rabbit hole and find the issue’s real root cause. Passionate advocate for the customer and improving their experience. Always there to mentor. Life-long teacher.

Capabilities: Problem solving, debugging, testing, customer focus, Ruby, RSpec, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, Chef, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS, Chef, IaaC, Java

Actively Learning: Terraform/Ansible/Kubernetes

positions.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed team of 5-7 with daily stand-ups during 2 yr. data center migration and decommission process.
• Led contractor team to maintain and patch legacy Verifi data center through infrastructure challenges.
• Led project to automate CloverDX during frequent data center failovers, saving 4 min (50% decrease).
• Administered OpenStack and AWS platforms supporting 400+ VMs using Chef 14, Datadog, and Splunk.
• Diagnosed, triaged, and resolved hundreds of client issues working with client services team.
• Worked with developers to identify root causes of performance and reliability issues.
• Successfully mentored and taught team members to learn junior-level Python software development.
• Continually captured institutional knowledge, processes, and tool usage in detailed runbooks.
• Reduced new client onboarding process with automation, saving 1 week (25% decrease). 
• Wrote Python tool to update CloverDX dependencies during releases, saving 18 min (92% decrease).
• Wrote Python tool to validate images in DTR before releases, saving 5 min per app (83% decrease).
• Maintained and debugged CI/CD pipelines using Bamboo/Jenkins/Docker/Aqua/Terraform/helm/k8s.
• Wrote Python tool to combine independent Grafana panels into custom single-pane dashboard.
• Identified orphaned AWS (no ELB association) instances using aws-sdk, saving 27% monthly.
• Eliminated critical monitoring gap by sending Datadog custom metrics based on DB source of truth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical lead for customer service team. Diagnosed, triaged, and resolved hundreds of customer issues across all product lines. Debugged and fixed complicated technical issues in API/system code.
• Developed modern React.js/Redux SPA using ES6/JavaScript/Node.js in 4 months to replace legacy Rails 4.x support portal used by large customer service team. Saved 5 min of developer time for each frequent account maintenance action. Created 30+ supporting APIs by refactoring existing Rails UI controller logic to share common code, verified with 100% RSpec coverage. Comprehensive Reducer tests for all API to Redux state transformations using Jest.
• Developed JWT-based file download system to workaround issue with presigned S3 URLs expiring due to ElasticBeanstalk container IAM keys expiring
• Developed tracking system using NewRelic insights and Rails 4.x front-end for a 3rd party integration.
• Developed prototype for system-wide document processing tracking using TypeScript, NestJS, and TypeORM.

positions.title: DevOps / Cloud Plumber
positions.description:
• Improved the scalability, reliability, and performance of the AWS infrastructure supporting Neat's customers. 
• Maintained, nursed, and managed AWS EC2-based MongoDB and Elasticsearch database clusters through normal upgrades and critical performance, maintenance, scalability, and reliability improvements.
• Participated in small on-call rotation responsible for production infrastructure.
• Developed custom Chef recipes, CloudFormation, Ruby tools, bash scripts, auto-scaling groups with custom hooks, Slack interfaces, Loggly API tools, NewRelic queries, Mongo shell scripts, AWS Athena, Grafana dashboards, and Scout plugins to deploy, manage, and monitor AWS infrastructure deployed to EC2 Ubuntu/Windows.
• Discovered, diagnosed, and fixed complex system and technical problems. 
• Created automated or self-service solutions to recurring issues. 
• Produced detailed documentation for manual procedures and solutions in knowledge base.
• Wrote integration plumbing code and testing specs in Ruby/Scala/PHP.
• Developed blue-green deployment for autoscaled Windows worker instances. 
• Fixed zero-downtime deployment strategy based on in-place mutable Chef node convergence for Rails-based server/worker instances to replace previous 3am scheduled outage deployments
• Developed custom ETL using AWS Data Pipeline, Elastic Map Reduce, and Hive to extract and ingest data from Mongo used for daily business usage reporting posts to Slack until replaced by Domo

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
• Led development of native Android app. Refactored complicated codebase from outsourced team.
• Developed extensive suite of Robolectric unit tests for critical client-side code.
• Developed backend APIs to interface with mobile apps using Ruby, Sinatra, and RSpec.
• Mentored developers transitioning from other platforms on mobile/Android development.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed event directory app that supported multiple events/event discovery and enabled dynamic UI customization based on the event. Created extensive suite of Robolectric unit tests for API interactions.
• Completely overhauled event guide app to use Fragments/Loaders/ActionBar to deliver 2012
American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) conference app.
• Designed and developed version 1.0 of event guide app. Implemented using Gson JSON, multi-table ContentProvider, IntentService, AsyncTask, customized ListViews. Deployments included the 1st Philadelphia International Festival of the Arts (PIFA), 2011 Philly Beer Week (PBW), 2011 Live Arts & Fringe.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Contracted on iOS parenting app that used custom UIView, UITableView/UITableViewCell, CoreAnimation, and CoreData for form entry and data display.
• Contracted on iOS tourism guide app that used CoreData, UITableView, custom UIView, and Address Book integration
• Pro bono developer for 2010 Philly Live Arts & Fringe Festival iOS app based on PBW iOS app that required custom Tessitura XML event feed processing and major iOS 4 technology upgrade, shipped in aggressive one-month timeframe
• Participated as key developer on pro bono team for 2010 Philly Beer Week (PBW) iOS app. Used CoreData, UITableView, MKMapView w/annotations, JSON data feed parsing.

positions.title: Software Developer, Banner Relationship Management
positions.description:
• Crafted well-designed user interfaces and supporting mid-tier code using Flex, ActionScript 3, Java, Spring, Swing, and JUnit.
• Top bug fixer. Refactored other developers' code for robustness and maintainability. Mentored junior developers. Participated in intense 18-month creation of initial 1.0 release.

positions.title: ActionLine Support, Banner Workflow
positions.description: • Technical lead for front-line technical phone support. Triaged and managed hundreds of client issues to resolution, sometimes under extreme time pressure with the client watching live via web conference.

positions.title: Trainer/Mentor, Banner Workflow Transition Team
positions.description:
• Developed training materials and knowledge base to transition knowledge of UI development for Workflow product to new Bangalore-based team. 100% remote training.
• Mentored developers using individual weekly late night 1-on-1 sessions emphasizing real learning over quick results.

positions.title: Software Developer, Banner Workflow
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented major parts of Java Swing graphical workflow modeler. Top bug-fixer.
• Designed and implemented Struts 1.2 web UIs, including pre-jQuery dynamic HTML workflow status monitor.
• Developed mid-tier EJB services, DAO persistence with SQL queries, JUnit tests.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
• Developed proof-of-concept prototype for EJB 1.1 3-tier application running on WebLogic.
• Performed load testing using Mercury LoadRunner.
• Presented report about prototype results to upper management.

volunteerExperiences.description: • Tutored an adult learner twice a week on mathematical subjects including fractions and basic algebra to support their goals to attend community college.

• Taught youth ages from 5-10 basic HTML and CSS coding, with a focus on reinforcing the mindset required to enjoy and successfully solve technical problems. The curriculum was ad-hoc, JIT, and fairly experimental, as Coded by Kids was still in the process of standardizing their roles, process, and curriculum.
